create_base.title: Create a managed Red Queen registry
create_base.description: Select Home Assistant areas for a new installation.

add_room.title: Add room from Home Assistant
add_room.description: Select a Home Assistant area. The room name and semantic ID are generated automatically. The area's existing floor assignment is used automatically; only for an area without a floor may you optionally select a Home Assistant floor. Red Queen does not change the HA area or floor registry.

data_description.area_id: The area name becomes the Red Queen room name.
data_description.floor_id: Only needed when the area is not assigned to a floor in Home Assistant.

add_light.title: Add light
add_light.description: Add a pulse-controlled light. Red Queen creates the semantic light ID automatically from room and light name and uses the binary feedback as its objective state.

data_description.name: For example: Spots, Ceiling light or Work light.
data_description.feedback_entity_id: Objective feedback entity of type binary_sensor.*.

add_cover.title: Add venetian blind
add_cover.description: Choose the room, travel pulse commands and four objective state feedback entities. The semantic cover ID is generated automatically from room and name. Position feedback is optional. If blade control is enabled, a second step asks for the two blade pulse commands.

data_description.cover_name: Example: Street blind, patio door or left window.
data_description.cover_open_command_entity_id: button.* pulse entity for opening travel.
data_description.cover_close_command_entity_id: button.* pulse entity for closing travel.
data_description.cover_closed_percent_feedback_entity_id: Optional sensor.* using 0 = open and 100 = closed.
data_description.cover_blades_enabled: Optional. Enable when separate blade-open/blade-close pulse commands exist.

add_cover_blades.title: Optional blade control
add_cover_blades.description: Choose the two separate blade pulse commands. Red Queen qualifies only command dispatch here and does not claim a blade position without objective feedback.

add_opening.title: Add opening
add_opening.description: Choose the opening type. Red Queen generates the semantic ID automatically from room and name.

add_window.title: Add window
add_window.description: Choose the room and objective open/closed feedback. For binary_sensor.* on means open and off means closed.

data_description.opening_name: Example: Street window, patio door or basement door.
data_description.opening_state_entity_id: Objective binary_sensor.* feedback. on = open, off = closed.

add_sliding_door.title: Add sliding door
add_sliding_door.description: Choose the room and objective open/closed feedback. For binary_sensor.* on means open and off means closed.

data_description.opening_name: Example: Street window, patio door or basement door.
data_description.opening_state_entity_id: Objective binary_sensor.* feedback. on = open, off = closed.

add_door.title: Add door
add_door.description: Choose the room and objective door-contact feedback. Motor lock and electric door release are optional and are configured in follow-up steps.

data_description.opening_name: Example: Front door, basement door or side entrance.
data_description.opening_state_entity_id: Objective binary_sensor.* door contact. on = open, off = closed.
data_description.door_lock_enabled: Optional. Enable when objective lock feedback plus separate lock/unlock pulses are available.
data_description.door_opener_enabled: Optional. Enable when a separate electric door-release pulse is available.

add_door_lock.title: Configure motor lock
add_door_lock.description: Choose objective lock feedback and the two separate pulse commands. Red Queen permits lock/unlock only while the door is objectively closed.

data_description.lock_feedback_entity_id: binary_sensor.* with on = locked and off = unlocked.

add_door_opener.title: Configure electric door release
add_door_opener.description: Choose the electric door-release pulse. Red Queen enables it only while the door is objectively closed and does not claim physical door opening.

data_description.door_opener_command_entity_id: button.* pulse entity for electric latch release.

add_garage_door.title: Add garage door
add_garage_door.description: Configure two objective end-position feedbacks and the pulse command. Red Queen only moves from an unambiguous opposite end position toward the requested direction.

data_description.garage_toggle_command_entity_id: button.* pulse entity for garage movement.
data_description.garage_movement_timeout_seconds: Safety timeout for observed travel. Allowed: 1 to 300 seconds.

add_plant.title: Add plant
add_plant.description: Create one plant in the selected Red Queen room. The semantic plant ID is generated automatically from room and plant name. Plant Care calculates watering status from the watering interval and confirmed watering events.

data_description.plant_name: Individual name, for example Office Dragon Tree or Monstera 1.
data_description.plant_location: For example windowsill, left shelf or south side. Empty = room name.
data_description.plant_watering_interval_days: Number of days after which Red Queen considers the next watering due. Allowed: 1 to 365 days.
data_description.plant_moisture_sensor_entity_id: An optional sensor.* is stored in the registry. In RC11 Plant Care intentionally remains interval/history based and does not infer watering decisions from this sensor yet.

dashboard.title: Red Queen dashboard
dashboard.description: Status: {dashboard_status}. Path: {dashboard_path}. Generated model: {floors} floors, {rooms} rooms, {lights} lights, {covers} covers, {openings} openings, {garages} garage doors and {plants} plants. Native entity bindings: {bindings_resolved}/{bindings_expected} resolved, {binding_issues} issues. The dashboard is created or updated only by the explicit action selected below.

error.invalid_commissioning_selection: Select at least one valid Home Assistant area.
error.cannot_write_registry: The registry could not be safely validated or written.
error.cannot_apply_object: The object is invalid or conflicts with the registry. No file was changed.
error.invalid_area: The selected Home Assistant area no longer exists.
error.invalid_floor: The selected Home Assistant floor no longer exists.
error.area_floor_mismatch: The area is already assigned to a different Home Assistant floor. Leave the floor field empty or select the floor already assigned there.
error.room_already_configured: This Home Assistant area is already configured as a Red Queen room.
error.light_already_configured: A light with this name already exists in this Red Queen room.
error.cover_already_configured: A venetian blind with this name already exists in this Red Queen room.
error.opening_already_configured: An opening with this name already exists in this Red Queen room.
error.plant_already_configured: A plant with this name already exists in this Red Queen room.

abort.commissioning_state_lost: The commissioning draft was lost. Start again.
abort.no_rooms_configured: No valid Red Queen rooms are configured.
abort.cover_configuration_state_lost: The venetian-blind draft was lost. Start the configuration again.
abort.opening_configuration_state_lost: The opening draft was lost. Start the configuration again.
abort.dashboard_generation_failed: The Red Queen dashboard could not be processed: {error}

door_open_lock_blocked.message: The door is open. Locking or unlocking is only allowed while the door is closed.

door_open_release_blocked.message: The door release is only available while the door is objectively closed.

cover_blades_moving.message: The blades can only be adjusted after the cover has stopped moving.

cover_reversal_blocked.message: The cover is already moving in the opposite direction. Wait for a stable state before reversing direction.

garage_stop_not_moving.message: STOP is only available while the garage door is objectively moving.

garage_moving_blocked.message: The garage door is already moving. Another drive pulse is blocked for safety.

garage_intermediate_blocked.message: The garage door is between its end positions. Red Queen cannot safely determine the next direction.

garage_feedback_conflict.message: The garage end-position feedback is contradictory. No drive command will be sent.

garage_feedback_unavailable.message: The garage end-position feedback is unavailable. No drive command will be sent.

garage_end_state_required.message: The garage door must be proven open or closed before a drive command is allowed.

command_unavailable.message: The configured command entity is currently unavailable.

canonical_action_rejected.message: Red Queen rejected action {action_id} because of the current state or a safety rule.
